runs.name: CDT Environmental Technology Investment Holdings Limited; Nasdaq CDTG, SEC CIK 0001793895, Cayman Islands, office in Shenzhen, 20-F filer; sewage treatment systems and sewage treatment services in urban and rural China, a septic-tank line being wound down and a green hydrogen start-up with no revenue; 1-for-25 share consolidation effective 2026-06-01; extraordinary general meeting of 2026-07-28 changed the Chinese name and raised the authorised capital; the 20-F names no rival, only regional competitors
runs.box: OUT AT Q2 (the deciding part's castle open on the filer's own evidence: customers who have stopped paying, a product its suppliers can make, falling volume; computation only beneath the stop)
runs.entry: The v5 re-run order, unattended work-hours cycle, one dispatched analyst under the canonical brief, from scratch. The brief's departures: the repository path after the move of 2026-10-25; the lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the 20-F's Items 4, 3.D and 5 (in place of a 10-K's Items 1, 1A and 7); the sovereign for the renminbi from its issuing authority, since the protocol's table has no CNY row. Price **$1.02** (close 2026-10-28, Yahoo, aggregator, flagged) x **3,021,000 shares** (Class A only: 13,525,000 at 2025-12-31 on the 20-F cover, plus 62,000,000 sold 2026-04-17 at $0.105, then 1-for-25, 6-K 0001731122-26-000796; cross-checked against Jane Street's 13G) = cap **$3.08M**; sovereign **2.0467%** (China treasury 30-year, the Ministry of Finance curve served by ChinaBond, 2026-10-29); exchange rate RMB 6.7147 to the dollar (CFETS central parity for the People's Bank of China, 2026-10-29). Filings: 20-F FY2025 0001731122-26-000740, 20-Fs FY2023 and FY2024, the 20-F/A of 2025-09-09 and the company's SEC correspondence of 2025-08-26 and 2025-09-09, the IPO 424B4 of 2024-04-18, the 6-Ks of 2026. **Q1 IN** (narrowly): sewage treatment systems decide, 93% of five-year gross profit; the hydrogen line is a start-up with no revenue, carried to Q6. **Q2 OUT**: collection of progress billings fell from 99.3% (2018) to 3.1% (2025), nothing collected from the five major customers by 2026-04-30, days sales outstanding 894 at the end of 2025; the 20-F says its outside suppliers can make any of its systems; revenue $34.2M (2023) to $18.2M (2025); owner cash negative in every one of eight years filed, even at near-full collection; management's own declared move to green hydrogen. Q3 to Q12 NOT REACHED. The 20-F names no rival, so no rival filing was read and Q2 rests on the filer's own figures. Balance sheet 2018 to 2025: receivables and contract assets $11.2M to $83.4M, 0.79 to 4.58 times the year's revenue; payables $1.9M to $39.2M; taxes payable $1.1M to $10.3M with cash tax about nil; reported net income $13.6M against operating cash $(16.3)M over the eight years. Facts after the stop, recorded not judged: credit-loss provisions $6.46M (2024) and $14.69M (2025) after the company told the SEC on 2025-08-26 that customers' payment plans were credible and collections had accelerated; the April 2026 offering of 62M pre-consolidation shares at $0.105, 82% of the enlarged company, for $6.51M against $30.6M of book equity, the CEO's stake from 33.82% to 6.06%; press releases claim more than 150 plants, the 20-F more than 60; the auditor dismissed three days after the IPO closed; two material weaknesses; going-concern doubt; a filing that calls its structure a VIE in its Introduction and a direct holding in Item 4.A. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash FY2021 to FY2025 $(0.23)M to $(4.56)M a year, average $(2.82)M all-equity, $(2.92)M equity-only; value **$(45.61) a share**, the no-growth case alone; fair price all-equity **$(9.27)**, not positive, equity-only $(9.67), or $(7.56) with the offering's cash; no case earns the floor. Could not get: any rival filing (none named); the 2020 revenue from the statement (MD&A only); a reconciliation of HRT Financial's Form 3 and Form 4, which mark it a ten-percent owner while reporting under 10,000 shares, recorded not used. Dispatcher's slip: the brief's company line called the structure a VIE consolidated but not owned, from the 20-F's one Introduction sentence; the analyst found the rest of the filing describes a direct holding and recorded it (gap 7). Framework gaps for the operator: Q1's parts rule blind to a declared pivot; Q2's ordinary returns not saying reported or cash return (above 20% reported ROE 2021 to 2023 against negative cash every year); the competitor row when the filing names no rival; no CNY row in the sovereign table, and whether ChinaBond's service of the Ministry of Finance curve is the issuing authority; a non-positive fair price; a filing that states its structure two ways; a brief quoting a filing's self-description carries its inconsistency. Write-early kept, four commits. Dispatcher's check: check_framework PASS; no E-ids, all 37 ids in the ledger (analyst's check_ids.py), 11 adjacent fragment pairs checked by `dispatcher_check.py`, none flagged; no citation slip; no tracked research file over 200 KB. Contamination declared: CWST commit subjects in the opening git status and log, the memory index, one filtered listing of Test Runs for the name that returned nothing; none used. Position note filled at the fold: not held. Not armed: the box is not OUT at Q7 or IN.
runs.narr: OUT at Q2: a Chinese rural sewage-systems maker whose local-government customers have stopped paying (collection from 99.3% in 2018 to 3.1% in 2025, days sales outstanding 894), whose suppliers can make its product, whose revenue fell by almost half in two years and whose owner cash was negative in every filed year; management turning to green hydrogen; an April 2026 offering sold 82% of the company for $6.51M; computation only, value $(45.61) a share and fair price $(9.27) against $1.02. Not armed.
